portal.musteri.landing.faq.title: Before you begin
portal.musteri.landing.faq.subtitle: Brief answers about account access and the boundaries of the private sourcing process.
portal.musteri.landing.faq.price.questio: Can I view prices as soon as I create an account?
portal.musteri.landing.faq.price.answer: No. Your business application is reviewed after email verification. Products, prices, offers, and documents become available only after the account is approved.
portal.musteri.landing.faq.link.question: Can I submit a request without a product link?
portal.musteri.landing.faq.link.answer: Yes. You can create a request with a photo and description, and add notes such as quantity, dimensions, colour, or intended use.
portal.musteri.landing.faq.payment.quest: Can I make a payment through the portal?
portal.musteri.landing.faq.payment.answe: No. The portal has no virtual POS or collection function. You may only submit a receipt notice for a deposit paid externally.
portal.musteri.landing.faq.intent.questi: Does responding to an offer constitute a confirmed order?
portal.musteri.landing.faq.intent.answer: No. Product responses are commercial statements of intent for preorder evaluation. Final terms are confirmed separately.
